title: Grand Theft Auto VI can now be pre-loaded, nine days before its 19 November launch
dek: Rockstar says everyone who pre-ordered can download the game now. It is a 212 GB file on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles.
what: Rockstar Games' account posted on 10 November 2026 that pre-loading is available to everyone who has pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI, and pointed to a 19 November launch.

Game Informer reports the game launches on 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and Series S. It reports the pre-load is 212 GB and opened at midnight local time on 10 November on PS5, and the evening of 9 November Eastern on Xbox.
Game Informer also reports that boxed versions are download codes only, with no disc, at retailers from 12 November. It reports the game runs at 30 frames per second on all consoles.
A separate Rockstar post announces a live event, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, on 21 November in Miami. I read only the post, not Rockstar's page.
why: The game has a large audience waiting for it, and pre-load is the step that makes launch day real for players.
next: Launch is 19 November. Whether the game unlocks on time is the next fact to check.

sources.label: Game Informer: You can preload Grand Theft Auto VI on PS5 and Xbox next week
